info.why-collation-forms-matter.title: Dalilin da ya sa fom ɗin tattarawa ke da muhimmanci
info.why-collation-forms-matter.body: Ana tattarawa a matakai uku: unguwa (EC8B), karamar hukuma (EC8C) da jiha (EC8D). Hawkeye yana duba jimillar kowane fom da takardun rumfunan zaɓe da ke ƙarƙashinsa, don haka idan lambar jam'iyya ta ragu yayin hawa sama ana yi mata alama a bainar jama'a — wannan gibi tsakanin rumfunan da jimillar da aka sanar shi ne inda aka fi sauya ƙidaya.
info.what-happens-to-this-report.title: Abin da ke faruwa da wannan rahoto
info.what-happens-to-this-report.body: An sanya hannu kan rahotonka a wannan na'ura kuma an rubuta shi a littafin jama'a mai nuna sauyi, don haka ba za a iya gyara shi ko janye shi daga baya ba. Ana duba shi da shaidar rumfunan zaɓe na wannan yanki, kuma ana wallafa yatsansa a littafin bayyanawa na Rekor a sanarwar yau da kullum ta gaba.
info.how-the-docket-works.title: Yadda Rijistar Jama'a ke aiki
info.how-the-docket-works.body:
Alama ba ta yanke hukunci kan komai — tana riƙe ƙuri'un wannan rumfa a waje da kowace jimilla har sai jama'a sun share ta.

Dalilin da ya sa ake cire sakamako mai jayayya — har sai jama'a sun duba alamar, ƙuri'un rumfar na nan a waje da kowace jimilla. Riƙe sakamako mai yiwuwa ya lalace yayin da ake dubansa ya fi aminci da barin shi ya kumbura jimilla; ba a goge komai, sai dai a ajiye shi a gefe har sai an share shi ko an soke shi.

Wa ke yanke hukunci, da yadda ake yi — masu lura da aka tabbatar a duniya, ba Hawkeye ba. Kowanne yana amsa tambayoyi na gaskiya game da shaidar da ke fayil: hoton takardar sakamako, hoton wurin, da alamar GPS. Babu wanda ke Hawkeye da ke yanke hukunci.

Rijistar tana kan sarkar — ana ƙara kowane ƙara, hukunci da warwarewa a sarkar rijistar mai nuna sauyi, wadda aka ɗaure a littafin bayyanawa na jama'a. Alkalan suna da tabbaci kamar ƙidayar kanta.
info.what-appears-here.title: Abin da ke bayyana a nan
info.what-appears-here.body: Tashin hankali, siyan ƙuri'a, gazawar BVAS, hana masu lura aiki da sauransu, waɗanda masu lura suka kai rahoto a wurin. An sa mutum ya duba kowane rahoto da ke wannan shafi kafin a wallafa shi — ba a lissafa rahotannin da ake kan dubawa ba.
info.what-to-report-and-what-happens-nex: Abin da za ka kai rahoto, da abin da ke biyo baya

Tashin hankali, ƙwace akwatin zaɓe, siyan ƙuri'a, tsoratar da masu zaɓe, gazawar BVAS, jinkirin kayan aiki, hana masu lura aiki — duk abin da ya shafi zaɓen. Mutum yana duba kowane rahoto kafin ya bayyana; ana wallafa waɗanda aka amince da su a jerin da ke ƙasa, ana gane su da ID ɗin mai lura kaɗai.
info.what-gets-checked.title: Abin da ake bincika
info.what-gets-checked.body: Ƙuri'u fiye da kima, adadin masu zaɓe da ba zai yiwu ba, lambobin fom ɗin jabu, ƙidaya masu karo da juna da kuma abubuwan da suka fita daban. Alama alama ce ta neman bincike, ba hukunci ba — kuma ba ta taɓa zama shaidar magudi ba.
info.digit-distribution-screening.title: Binciken rabon lambobi
info.digit-distribution-screening.body: Lambobin ƙirƙira sukan taru kan lambobin da aka fi so, yayin da ƙidaya ta gaskiya ke bin rabe-raben da aka sani — dokar Benford ga lambar farko, da rabo kusan daidai ga lambar ƙarshe. Bambanci yana nufin waɗannan lambobin sun cancanci ƙarin dubawa, ba fiye da haka ba. Zaɓe na gaskiya yana haifar da rabe-rabe masu ban mamaki saboda dalilai marasa laifi, don haka alama a nan gayyata ce ta duba shaida, ba hukuncin magudi ba.
info.inec-irev-cross-check.title: Gwaji da INEC IReV
info.inec-irev-cross-check.body: Ga kowace rumfar zaɓe, ana kwatanta ƙidayar da jama'a suka kai rahoto da takardar EC8A da INEC kanta ta ɗora a tashar duba sakamako (IReV) — shaidar INEC ana duba ta da ta jama'a, ba a amince da ɗaya fiye da ɗaya ba. Duk bambanci yana bayyana a cikin banbance-banbancen da ke sama, tare da hanyar haɗi kai tsaye zuwa takardar INEC domin ka duba da kanka.
info.collation-reconciliation.title: Daidaita tattarawa
info.collation-reconciliation.body: Ana duba jimillar tattarawa ta unguwa (EC8B), karamar hukuma (EC8C) da jiha (EC8D) da takardun rumfunan zaɓe da aka gina su a kai. Lambar da aka tattara ba za ta taɓa zama ƙASA da jimillar rumfunan da aka rufe ba — idan ta zama haka, wannan shaida ce ta lissafi ta rage lamba, ba batun ra'ayi ba, kuma ana yi mata alama a cikin banbance-banbancen da ke sama. Wannan shi ne matakin da aka fi sauya ƙidaya.
info.how-the-chain-is-checked.title: Yadda ake bincika sarkar
info.how-the-chain-is-checked.body: Kowane shigarwa yana ajiye yatsan wanda ya gabace shi, don haka sauya ko cire duk wani rahoto na baya yana karya kowane yatsa da ke bayansa. Wannan shafi yana sake lissafa dukkan sarkar a cikin burauzarka kuma yana kwatanta kan da ya samu da wanda muke wallafawa — ba sai ka amince da mu ba.
info.verifying-a-single-race.title: Tabbatar da gasa ɗaya
info.verifying-a-single-race.body: Kowace sanarwa tana haɗa kowace gasa — Shugaban Ƙasa, da kowace gasar Majalisar Dattawa, Majalisar Wakilai, Gwamna da Majalisar Jiha — a cikin tushen Merkle ɗaya da aka wallafa a Rekor. Tabbatar da gasa ɗaya yana naɗe reshen wannan gasa kaɗai, a cikin burauzarka, ba tare da sake kunna kowace gasa ba ko amincewa da mu ba.
info.reading-this-page.title: Karanta wannan shafi
info.reading-this-page.body: Ana rina kowace jiha da launin jam'iyyar da ke mulkinta. Taɓa ko sanya alama kan jiha domin ganin gwamnanta, jam'iyyarta da shekarar zaɓenta na gaba. Ana tattara lambobin daga bayanan jama'a kuma ana sabunta su yayin da ake sanar da sakamako.
info.where-these-numbers-come-from.title: Inda waɗannan lambobi suka fito
info.how-races-are-grouped.title: Yadda ake rarraba gasa
info.how-races-are-grouped.body: Mai gudana zaɓe ne da ake kai rahoto a kansa yau. Mai zuwa shi ne wanda ranar zaɓensa take gaba. Wanda ya kammala shi ne wanda ranar zaɓensa ta wuce — shafinsa yana nan, domin rikodin shi ne manufar. Jerin 'yan takara yana bayyana a shafin kowace gasa yayin da INEC ke wallafa su, kusan kwanaki 28 kafin lokaci.

terms.what-hawkeye-is-body: Hawkeye yana ba 'yan ƙasa damar ɗaukar hoto, sa hannu, da wallafa sakamakon da aka sanar a rumfar zaɓensu zuwa wani tarihi mai zaman kansa da ba a iya sauya shi. Hawkeye ba shi da wata alaƙa da INEC, wata hukumar gwamnati, ko wata jam'iyyar siyasa, kuma babu wanda ya amince da shi ko ya ba shi izini. Sakamakon zaɓe na hukuma su ne waɗanda INEC kaɗai ta sanar. Hawkeye yana samar da shaidun da jama'a suka bayar don a duba su a fili; ba ya sanar da wanda ya yi nasara, kuma ba zai iya ba.
terms.your-content-body: Rahotannin da ka aika — ƙidaya, hotuna, da wuraren da suka fito — ana wallafa su a littafin jama'a da ba a iya sauya shi, kuma bisa ƙira ba a iya gyara su ko goge su; wannan dawwama ce ke sa a amince da su. Da aikawa, kana ba Hawkeye izinin ajiyewa, wallafawa, da nuna wannan abun don bayyana gaskiyar zaɓe, a ko'ina a duniya, ba tare da biya ba kuma ba tare da keɓancewa ba. Ka tabbatar kana da haƙƙin aika shi. Ba a taɓa wallafa lambar wayarka ba — duba Manufar Sirri.

privacy.your-rights-body: Kana iya goge asusunka da kanka a kowane lokaci: buɗe shafin bayananka sannan ka zaɓi Goge asusuna. Wannan yana cire makullin sa hannunka, haɗin na'urarka, haɗin Telegram da rajistar sanarwa. Abubuwa biyu za su rage, bisa ƙira: bayanan littafin jama'a (na dindindin kuma maras suna — wannan dawwama ce ke sa a amince da su) da hash ɗin lambarka mai hanya ɗaya, wanda ake ajiyewa don kada a sake amfani da alamar da aka goge wajen kai rahoto iri ɗaya sau biyu. Sake yin rajista da lamba ɗaya yana mayar maka da ID ɗinka na asali. Sauran buƙatu ƙarƙashin Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya: info@hawkeye.com.ng.

captain-guide.title: Jagorar Kyaftin na Unguwa
captain-guide.lede: Kyaftin na unguwa yana tabbatar da cewa wani ya tsaya domin ƙidaya a kowane rukunin zaɓe na unguwa ɗaya. Kai mai sa kai ne, kuma Hawkeye ba ya goyon bayan kowace jam'iyya.
captain-guide.what-h: Abin da kyaftin na unguwa ke yi
captain-guide.what-1: Cike rukunan zaɓen da ba a rufe ba a unguwarka. Da zarar an amince da kai, ƙungiyar Hawkeye za ta faɗa maka da kanta waɗanne rukunan zaɓe ne har yanzu suke buƙatar wani.
captain-guide.what-2: Ka tabbatar kowane mai sa kai ya yi gwajin atisaye, sannan Ranakun Atisaye na Ƙasa a ranar Asabar 12 ga Disamba da Asabar 9 ga Janairu.
captain-guide.what-3: A makon zaɓe, aika da tunatarwa: ajiye rukunin zaɓenka, caji wayarka, kuma ka tsaya domin ƙidaya.
captain-guide.what-4: A ranar 16 ga Janairu, ka jefa ƙuri'a, sannan ka tsaya domin ƙidaya a rukunin zaɓenka ka ɗauki hoton sakamako idan an liƙa shi.
captain-guide.invite-1: Hanyar gayyatarka tana cikin Bayanaina, ƙarƙashin Gayyata. Raba ta a WhatsApp ko ta saƙon tes. Duk wanda ya yi rijista da ita zai bayyana a bayananka.
captain-guide.invite-2: Don ƙungiyoyi da allon sanarwa, raba shafin Sami Hawkeye.
captain-guide.invite-3: Kowane mai sa kai yana ajiye rukunin zaɓensa da kansa a manhajar. Kada ka taɓa tattara jerin wanda zai je ina.
captain-guide.rules-h: Ka zama ba ruwanka da jam'iyya
captain-guide.rules-1: Ka ɗauki kowa, daga kowace jam'iyya ko ba jam'iyya. Wakilan jam'iyya suna da maraba bisa sharuɗɗa iri ɗaya da kowa.
captain-guide.rules-2: Kada a sa sunayen jam'iyya, tambari, launuka ko take a duk abin da ka aika game da Hawkeye.
captain-guide.rules-3: Ka ce "a naɗi abin da aka sanar". Kada ka taɓa yin alƙawarin fallasa maguɗi, kuma kada ka yi hasashen wanda zai ci.
captain-guide.rules-4: Hawkeye ba INEC ba ne, kuma ba jam'iyya ba ne. Ka faɗi haka tun farko.
captain-guide.rules-5: Kada ka taɓa ba da kuɗi ko kyauta don shiga ko bayar da rahoto.
captain-guide.safety-h: Ka zauna lafiya kuma ka bi doka
captain-guide.safety-1: Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranka daraja. Idan an sami tashin hankali, ka bar wurin, ka kai rahoto daga baya daga wuri mai aminci.
captain-guide.safety-2: Kada ka taɓa tsoma baki ga jami'an zaɓe, masu zaɓe ko kayan zaɓe. Ka bi umarnin jami'ai.
captain-guide.safety-3: Ka bi Dokar Zaɓe da ƙa'idojin INEC. Ka ɗauki hoton abin da aka liƙa ko aka raba kawai.
captain-guide.never-h: Abin da Hawkeye ba ya taɓa yi
captain-guide.never-1: Ba ya taɓa bayyana wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe — ba a gare ka ba, ba ga jam'iyya ba, ba ga kowa ba.
captain-guide.never-2: Ba ya taɓa wallafa yawan rufewa ƙasa da matakin karamar hukuma.
captain-guide.never-3: Zama kyaftin ba ya ba ka damar ganin bayanan kowa a manhajar.

press.lede: Menene Hawkeye, yadda take aiki, muhimman ranaku, da fayilolin da za ku iya amfani da su a rahotonku.
press.summary: Hawkeye manhaja ce kyauta, mai buɗaɗɗen tushe, da ke ba kowane ɗan Najeriya a rukunin zaɓe damar ɗaukar hoton takardar sakamako (Fom EC8A) da aka sanar a wurin, ya kuma ƙara ta cikin rikodin jama'a da kowa zai iya dubawa. Ana kwatanta rahotanni daga rukuni ɗaya da juna, da kuma kwafin da INEC ke ɗorawa a shafinta na IReV, don kowa ya ga inda aka yi daidai ko aka saɓa. Hawkeye mai zaman kanta ce, ba ta goyon bayan kowace jam'iyya: ba ta sanar da sakamako, ba ƙidaya ce ta kishiya ba, kuma ba ta da alaƙa da INEC ko wata jam'iyya ko ɗan takara.
press.fact-what-v: Manhaja kyauta da 'yan ƙasa ke amfani da ita don ɗaukar hoto da ba da rahoton sakamakon da aka sanar a rukunin zaɓensu, su kuma kwatanta shi da IReV na INEC.

press.fact-code-v: A buɗe yake ga kowa a GitHub, tare da buɗaɗɗen ɗakin karatu na tantancewa da kowa zai iya gudanarwa.
press.fact-units-v: Ana iya ba da rahoton dukkan 176,846 da ke rijistar INEC.
press.fact-operator-v: IniXien Hope Initiative, ƙungiya mai zaman kanta ta Najeriya da ba ta neman riba (ana kan yi mata rijista). Kamfanin 'yar'uwarta, IniXien, LLC, ya ba ta damar amfani da Hawkeye kyauta har abada.
press.fact-status-v: Mai zaman kanta ce kuma ba ta goyon bayan kowace jam'iyya. Ba ta da alaƙa da INEC ko wata jam'iyya ko ɗan takara. Sakamako na hukuma su ne waɗanda INEC ta sanar.
press.step-1: Ɗauki hoton takardar. A rukunin zaɓe, mai lura yana ɗaukar hoton takardar sakamako da aka sanar da kuma wurin a cikin manhajar. Ana ɗaukar hotuna kai tsaye tare da alamar GPS; ba a karɓar hotuna daga gallery.
press.step-2: Sa hannu kuma a rubuta. Ana sanya hannu kan rahoton a wayar mai lura da kansa, da makullin da Hawkeye ba ta taɓa riƙewa ba, sannan a ƙara shi cikin rikodin jama'a da ba za a iya gyara shi a ɓoye ba.
press.step-3: Kwatanta a fili. Ana kwatanta rahotanni daga rukuni ɗaya da juna da kuma takardar INEC da kanta a IReV. Ana yi wa ƙidaya alamar an tabbatar ne kawai idan masu lura masu zaman kansu sun yi daidai, kuma ana nuna saɓani, ba a taɓa ɓoye shi ba.
press.trust-open: Buɗaɗɗen tushe. Lambobin manhajar suna a fili a GitHub, kuma buɗaɗɗen mai tantancewa yana ba kowa damar sake duba rikodin da kayan aikinsa.
press.trust-ledger: Littafin rikodi na jama'a. Kowane rahoto yana haɗe da wanda ya gabace shi, kuma ana wallafa sawun littafin a Sigstore Rekor, rikodin jama'a mai zaman kansa wanda Hawkeye ba ta gudanarwa. Kowa na iya sake duba shi a burauza, ba tare da asusu ba.
press.trust-photos: Sirrin hotuna. Takardun sakamako a fili suke, kamar yadda INEC ke liƙa su a rukunin zaɓe. Ba a taɓa wallafa hotunan wurin ba, domin za su iya nuna masu zaɓe. Ana adana lambobin waya a matsayin hash na hanya ɗaya kawai.
press.trust-nonpartisan: Ba ta goyon bayan kowace jam'iyya. Hawkeye ba ta sanar da wanda ya yi nasara, kuma ba ta goyon bayan wata jam'iyya ko ɗan takara. Ba ta karɓar kuɗin siyasa, kuma babu talla a cikinta.

cert.q1: Yaushe za ka ɗauki hoton takardar sakamako (EC8A)?
cert.q1-a: Da zarar ka isa rukunin zaɓe
cert.q1-b: Idan an sanar da sakamako kuma an liƙa shi bayan ƙidaya

cert.q2-why: Hotunan kai tsaye kaɗai: babu ɗorawa daga gallery, babu hoton allo. Ana sanya wa kowane hoto alamar GPS a lokacin da aka ɗauke shi, wanda ke sa rahoto ya yi wuyar ƙirƙira daga wani wuri.
cert.q3: Me za ka rubuta a cikin rahotonka?
cert.q3-b: Alkaluman da wani a rukunin ya faɗa maka
cert.q3-c: Adadin kowace jam’iyya daidai yadda aka sanar
cert.q3-why: Ka rubuta adadin da aka sanar na kowace jam’iyya daidai, sannan ka sanya hannu ka aika yayin da kake a rukunin. Rahotanni na dindindin ne: ba za a iya gyara ko share komai ba bayan an sanya hannu.
cert.q4: Yaya ya kamata ka yi mu’amala da jami’an zaɓe, masu zaɓe da kayan zaɓe?

cert.q4-b: Ka shiga tsakani idan kana ganin jami’i ya yi kuskure
cert.q4-c: Ka duba takardun ƙuri’a da kanka
cert.q4-why: Kada ka taɓa tsoma baki ga jami’an zaɓe, masu zaɓe ko kayan zaɓe. Ka bi umarnin jami’ai, kuma ka bi Dokar Zaɓe da ƙa’idojin INEC.
cert.q5: Tashin hankali ya ɓarke a rukunin zaɓenka. Me za ka yi?
cert.q5-a: Ka tsaya ka ci gaba da ɗaukar hotuna, komai ya faru
cert.q5-b: Ka bar wurin, ka kai rahoto daga baya daga wuri mai aminci
cert.q5-c: Ka yi ƙoƙarin dakatar da shi da kanka
cert.q5-why: Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranka daraja. Idan an sami tashin hankali, ka bar wurin, ka kai rahoto daga baya daga wuri mai aminci.
cert.q6: Yaushe ake yi wa ƙidaya alamar “an tabbatar”?
cert.q6-a: Da zarar mai lura ɗaya ya kai rahotonta
cert.q6-b: Idan an yaɗa ta sosai a intanet
cert.q6-c: Idan masu lura masu zaman kansu a rukuni ɗaya suka kai rahoton alkaluma iri ɗaya
cert.q6-why: Ba a amince da rahoto ɗaya shi kaɗai ba. Ana tabbatar da ƙidaya idan masu lura masu zaman kansu a rukuni ɗaya suka kai rahoton alkaluma iri ɗaya, tare da GPS, hotunan wuri masu kama da juna da lambobin da aka karanta daga takardar. Hawkeye ba ta sanar da sakamako: sakamako na hukuma na INEC ne.
cert.q7: Me Hawkeye ba ta taɓa bayyanawa ba?
cert.q7-a: Ƙidayar da aka kai rahotonta a rukunin zaɓe
cert.q7-b: Lambar wayarka, ko wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe
cert.q7-why: Ana yi wa lambar wayarka hash kuma ba a taɓa wallafa ta ko raba ta ba. Hawkeye ba ta taɓa bayyana wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe ba: ba ga kyaftin ba, ba ga jam’iyya ba, ba ga kowa ba.

stay.wa-message:
KU TSAYA DOMIN ƘIDAYA – 16 ga Janairu 2027

Hawkeye manhaja ce ta kyauta, mai zaman kanta: ba INEC ba ce, ba gwamnati ba ce, ba jam'iyyar siyasa ba ce.

Kafin 16 ga Janairu:
1. Ku shigar da Hawkeye Election Monitor ko Hawkeye Lite
2. Ku tabbatar da lambarku
3. Ku ajiye rukunin zaɓenku
4. Ku yi gwajin atisaye

A ranar zaɓe: ku jefa ƙuri'a, ku tsaya domin ƙidaya ko ku dawo. Idan an liƙa sakamako, ku ɗauki hotonsa da Hawkeye ku aika. Zai shiga littafin jama'a da kowa zai iya dubawa. Babu yanar gizo? Zai tafi daga baya.

Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranku daraja. Ku bi umarnin jami'an zaɓe. Kada ku tsoma baki, kada ku yi gardama. Ku ɗauki hoton abin da aka liƙa ko aka ba ku kawai.

https://hawkeye.com.ng/stay
